Class UserManager

java.lang.Object
AccountManager<User>
UserManager
public class UserManager extends AccountManager<User>
Singleton class that manages all user accounts in the Library Management System.

Extends AccountManager to provide account creation, login, logout, username/password updates, and user-specific operations such as unregistering users and promoting them based on borrowing history.

Ensures that users can only be unregistered if they have no unpaid fines and no active loans.

    • canUnregister

      public boolean canUnregister(User user)
      Checks if a user can be unregistered.

      A user can only be removed if they have:

      • No unpaid fines
      • No active (not returned) loans
      Parameters:
      user - the user to check
      Returns:
      true if the user can be unregistered, false otherwise

    • evaluateAndPromoteUser

      public void evaluateAndPromoteUser(User user)
      Evaluates the user's borrowing history and promotes them to a membership tier accordingly:
      • Regular: < 5 borrowed items
      • Silver: ≥ 5 borrowed items
      • Gold: ≥ 15 borrowed items

      Updates the user's FineCalculator to reflect the appropriate fine strategy for their membership tier.
